mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS cardId, i.institution_code AS institutionCode, i.institution_name AS institutionName, c.card_no_masked AS cardNoMasked, c.product_name AS productName, c.card_product_code AS cardProductCode, c.card_type_code AS cardTypeCode, c.card_status_code AS cardStatusCode, c.currency AS currency, DATE_FORMAT(c.issued_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS issuedAt, DATE_FORMAT(c.last_synced_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s+09:00') AS lastSyncAt FROM card c JOIN financial_institution i ON i.id = c.institution_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.card_status_code = '01' AND i.is_supported = 1 ORDER BY c.id
